summary_en: This study tests 18F Fluorocholine, a PET isotope bound to choline, in people with suspected parathyroid adenoma whose 99mTc Sestamibi SPECT/CT scan was negative or equivocal. Each participant receives one intravenous dose of 18F Fluorocholine (5 mCi ± 20%), and about 45 to 60 minutes later has a low-dose CT scan and a PET scan from the skull base to mid thighs. The main outcome is not stated in the record; the study phase is Phase 2/Phase 3.
summary_es: Este estudio evalúa 18F Fluorocholine, un isótopo PET unido a colina, en personas con sospecha de adenoma paratiroideo cuya gammagrafía SPECT/CT con 99mTc Sestamibi fue negativa o dudosa. Cada participante recibe una dosis intravenosa de 18F Fluorocholine (5 mCi ± 20%) y, aproximadamente de 45 a 60 minutos después, una TC de baja dosis y un PET desde la base del cráneo hasta la mitad de los muslos. El resultado principal no se indica en el registro; el estudio es de fase 2/fase 3.
who_for: Suspected parathyroid adenoma with high calcium and normal or high parathyroid hormone.
Negative or equivocal 99mTc Sestamibi SPECT/CT scan.
Karnofsky performance status above 50, or an equivalent ECOG/WHO score.
Total bilirubin and liver enzymes within the stated limits.
not_for: Younger than 18 years at the time of radiotracer dose.
Creatinine clearance below 60 mL/min or serum creatinine above 1.5 times the upper limit of normal.
QTcF above 470 msec on ECG, or congenital long QT syndrome.
Pregnant women, per the radiology department policy.
